issue.description:
ADR-005 documents the residual gap after the ready_frontier doctor check: "There is currently no way to mark an assignment as intentionally held", so an operator who legitimately parks an open assigned issue (a deliberate reservation) is indistinguishable from a worker's abandoned residue and gets warned on every doctor run — the ADR itself flags that this trains operators to ignore the warning. Work: add an explicit operator-set hold/reservation marker on an open assigned issue; make the doctor ready_frontier check suppress (or separately bucket) issues carrying it while staying advisory-only and never clearing assignees, not even under --repair; record the marker mutation as an audit event, persist it through checkpoint publication and restore round trips, and surface it in list/show. Must not conflict with the settle-on-release behavior (beadrs-b412cc80) or the manual_blocked surface work (beadrs-892eb8ce), which address different states.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add an intentional-hold marker so assignment-held issues can be distinguished from stale residue

issue.description:
Split child of beadrs-e34d5ef4 (auto-split). Verify and complete the side-object portion of the unknown-field corpus in tests/checkpoint_unknown_field_record_corpus.rs (helpers in tests/checkpoint_unknown_field_generation_conformance.rs; extension surface landed as commit 4995a70, payload helpers resource_key_level_payload() and attempt_outcome_level_payload() exist -- verify and close gaps, do not rebuild).

Scope: resource key, attempt outcome, and provenance receipt levels only (store-record levels and the generation pointer are covered by sibling children).

Acceptance criteria:
- Resource key, attempt outcome, and provenance receipt each carry a distinct, clearly-opaque extension value with a nested object and an array.
- A test asserts these side-object extensions survive flush and restore exactly (receipts round-trip; no silent drop or renumber).
- Suite green locally; evidence (test names, command, result) recorded on this bead before close.
issue.notes: Attempt 2's content work (dd1ea9b) verified sound -- the close gate failed for an environmental reason now fixed. Diagnosis: the corpus file built every workspace with bare TempDir::new(), which lands under the TMPDIR default. On this box /tmp/.beads sits above such tempdirs, workspace discovery stops there, and init --skip-foreign-workspace ADOPTS the ancestor store: exit 0, nothing created locally, then all 8 corpus tests fail on the config they never got (reproduced 8 of 8 failing under TMPDIR=/tmp at dd1ea9b-era HEAD). NEEDLE's bare re-run of the corpus command at close therefore failed the gate; the generation-conformance sibling file was already pinned to /var/tmp by 4995a70, the corpus file was not. Fix landed as 3909e38 and pushed: fresh_workspace() helper pinning all three corpus workspace roots to /var/tmp with the rationale in its doc comment, matching the conformance file idiom and the DoD script's documented base. No payload changes needed -- acceptance criterion 1 already holds at HEAD: future_key_exclusivity, future_telemetry, future_receipt_signature are distinct opaque keys, each an object carrying an array plus a nested gate object, at resource-key, attempt-outcome, and receipt levels respectively. Verified on a clean git-archive extraction of pushed HEAD 3909e38: full scripts/definition-of-done.sh (fmt + clippy + test) PASS; then in that same extraction with the ambient default TMPDIR (no override), corpus binary 8 passed 0 failed including published_checkpoint_carries_unknown_fields_at_every_object_level and receipts_round_trip_exactly, conformance binary 3 passed 0 failed including unknown_fields_survive_every_level_across_generations and a_dropped_unknown_field_fails_the_preservation_assertions. Extraction removed after success. origin/main at 3909e38, rev-list origin/main..HEAD empty. The staged .beads checkpoint churn in the index was preserved untouched throughout (partial-path landing).
issue.title: Extend unknown-field corpus for resource-key, attempt-outcome, and provenance-receipt levels

issue.description:
Implement the post-0.1 R025 feature from ADR-001: let authors declare a `verifies` relationship and report when a `blocks` edge runs from a verifier to the work it verifies. Keep the diagnosis advisory and rely only on declared relationships, never title heuristics. Add tests for detection, non-detection when no relationship is declared, and confirmation that the diagnostic does not change edge acceptance or readiness.
